data.name: [🔥UPDATE 1] Prehistoric Farm
data.description:
🦖 Welcome to Prehistoric Farm 🦖

Dig up the past and bring it back to life! Sail across wild islands, unearth ancient fossils, and turn them into eggs at Dr. Ivy's DNA Lab. Hatch your very own dinosaurs, raise them from tiny Newborns into huge Elders, and ride them across your ranch!

[How To Play]
▪ Grab your shovel and hold down on a dig site. Let go when the meter is in the green for a better find!
▪ Collect a full set of fossils and bring them to Dr. Ivy to grow an egg
▪ Warm your egg in the incubator and watch it hatch
▪ Keep your dino's belly over half full so it keeps growing
▪ Once it's grown, hop on and ride your partner dino around the islands!

[Explore]
▪ Buy bigger boats and sail to new fossil islands
▪ Fish the open sea and dive for rare catches
▪ Sneak into the Sunken Grotto to steal sea reptile eggs
▪ Team up with other players to take down the giant Mosasaurus with spears!

Works on PC, mobile and console.

Start from nothing and become the most powerful mafia boss in this 2D mafia game inspired by the game Mafia Wars from 2009. There is one persistent map and the game moves 24/7. Your properties keep earning while you sleep, your crew keeps defending your turf, and rival Families keep plotting.

🔫 Attack other players and steal their cash
🤝 Hire henchmen and equip them with weapons, armor, and vehicles
👥 Join a Family, go to war, and take over the map
🏆 Earn trophies and climb the leaderboards

⚔️ [将] SHOGUN'S REIGN 🏯

From the fields to the throne, your destiny is yours to claim.

Welcome to [将] Shogun's Reign, a roleplaying and progression experience set in the world of Edo-period Japan, where every player begins with little more than the clothes on their back.

🌾 Work the fields. Earn your first Ryō through farming, labor, and humble trades.

🏮 Find your place. Explore bustling towns, mountain villages, shrines, estates, and the dangerous roads that connect them.

⚔️ Rise through society. Build your wealth and reputation, master a profession, serve those above you, or take a more dangerous path toward power.

🏯 Climb the ranks. Become a respected warrior, influential noble, or powerful feudal lord as you compete with others for status and authority.

👑 Claim the Shogunate. At the very top stands one position above all others: Shogun. Gain enough influence, wealth, and power, and the realm itself may one day fall under your rule.
